gameDescriptionHtml:
What is Pocket & Zooom? Pocket & Zooom is a puzzle game in which you give commands to aircraft to guide them to their destinations. Players can give only six kinds of commands. It’s more difficult than it sounds. Create a strategy to get the aircraft to their destinations!

Game Features

  • Always keep your eye on the airport! Aircraft move steadily towards their destinations, but without your guidance they can easily collide with other aircraft or obstacles. Keep a close eye on conditions at the airport, quickly find aircraft that are heading into dangerous situations and avoid the danger.
  • Give commands to the aircraft! Use “command cards” to keep the aircraft away from danger. Choose the appropriate command from six command cards, including “Stop” and “Change Route,” to guide the aircraft to their destinations.
  • Be careful not to use too many cards! After using a card, there is a “cooldown” time during which you have to wait before you can use another card. Think carefully about timing when you use a card.
  • Guide all the aircraft to their destinations! Safely avoid various dangers and get the aircraft to their destinations to be a hero! If you only had to guide one aircraft it might be easy. But with each new stage, the number of aircraft increases and the dangers become more frequent. Guide all the aircraft to their destinations to clear the stage!
